images.prompt: A cinematic, high-contrast scene of a glowing digital fortress representing a cybersecurity network. A central orchestrator made of flowing luminous data streams connects three abstract AI agents: Thinker (a radiant geometric brain), Worker (a multi-tooled construct), and Verifier (a crystalline shield). Holographic status panels float nearby with graphs showing '86.9%' and '72.1%'. Deep navy and cyber-magenta tones, volumetric lighting, intricate data motes floating in the air, unreal engine 5, 8k, moody and technologically sublime.
images.altText: Conceptual cinematic rendering of the Fugu-Cyber orchestration model routing tasks between Thinker Worker and Verifier AI agents
images.caption: Concept art visualizing Fugu-Cyber's orchestration architecture.

images.prompt: A clean, professional diagram in a dark blue and teal aesthetic illustrating Fugu-Cyber's three core agents. The Verifier is a shield icon inspecting a crash proof-of-concept. Flowing luminous arrows connect them in a continuous triangular cycle. Glassmorphism panels, wireframe overtones, isometric perspective, sleek and informative design.

images.prompt: A detailed technical illustration of the recursive agentic scaffolding loop architecture.
